name: Daily Facility Safety Check
description: Demonstrates conditional rules: follow-up questions that appear only when needed, comment and evidence requirements, a temperature warning and a section that is revealed by a Yes/No answer. Every behaviour below is configuration - no question is special-cased in code.

sections.name: Daily check
sections.description: Answer the questions in order; follow-up questions appear when an answer needs more detail.

items.question: Is the refrigerator temperature within the acceptable range?

sections.name: Additional equipment inspection
sections.description: Only shown when additional equipment inspection applies.

items.question: Has the grease trap been cleaned this week?

rules.name: Blocked fire exit needs detail and a photo
rules.description: Follow-up questions are revealed, and the detail and the photo become mandatory.

actions.prompt: Say what is blocking the exit

rules.name: Temperature warning
rules.description: Warn when the fridge is reported out of range, or the recorded temperature is above 5 or below 0 (an OR with a nested group).

actions.message: The refrigerator is outside the safe 0 to 5 °C range. Move stock and report it to maintenance.

rules.name: Additional equipment inspection section
rules.description: The section is hidden until the Yes/No answer says it applies.

actions.message: Fire exit and refrigeration both failed. Escalate to the area manager now.
